Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Doorstep contracts carry a fourteen-day cooling-off period.

At first, Tom found it difficult to keep the habit. People around Tom often share different ideas about the discount area. Tom keeps a small rabbit at home and feeds it every morning. In fact, the seasonal sale starts in June.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Little by little, things began to change. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. The cat likes to sleep on the bottom stair.

The shopping mall has become an important part of daily life. On Thursday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. Tom prefers windy weather when running in the supermarket. A mouse ran across the kitchen floor.
Tom has practiced chess for three years and won a prize last term. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
